categories.title: Checkpoint
categories.info: Points you can Teeleport to directly, so long as you're already in this Layer as a whole. A few are also Transition points.

categories.title: Chip Exchange
categories.info:
Exchange Banadium Chips for Banandium Gems, starting at 10 Chips and increasing by 10 for every purchase.

Note that the first Gem purchased on each layer is the only one that will count towards your collection.

categories.title: Getaway
categories.info: Speak to the Architectone to exchange gold for a getaway. Each one comes with a bed to restore health, closet for changing clothes, and gramophone to play music discs.

categories.title: Rehearsal Hall
categories.info: Rehearsal Halls are large-scale challenges that focus on a specific Bananza form. They can only be accessed after finishing the story.

categories.title: Style Shop
categories.info: Style Shops let you buy and upgrade cosmetic items using the local Fossils in that layer.

categories.title: Transition
categories.info: Transitions are Blast Barrel passageways between Sublayers

categories.title: Banandium Gem
categories.info: Collecting 5 Banandium Gems allow you to upgrade DK's abilities through Skill Points.

categories.title: Clothing
categories.info: Clothing can be purchased (and sometimes upgraded) at Style Shops for fossils. They grant a wide variety of gameplay benefits.

categories.title: Extra-Rare Fossil
categories.info: Extra-Rare Fossils are used for the final upgrade of the showpiece Style Shop items.

categories.title: Fossil
categories.info: Common Fossils are used to buy the lowest-grade cosmetics at Style Shops, as well as buy their first upgrade.

categories.title: Rare Fossil
categories.info: Rare Fossils are used to buy and upgrade showpiece Style Shop items, as well as buy the final upgrade of more common items.

categories.title: Shifty Smash
categories.info: Shifty Smash Challenges begin by punching the triangular pyramid, which will spawn one or several Shifty Blocks in the area. Destroy them all within the time limit to complete the challenge.

locations.title: 01 - Branched into the Forest Layer!
locations.description: **Location:** Buried in the ground, just in front of the [Beaky Thicket](#loc=469985).

locations.title: 02 - Battle: Thorn-Forest Throwdown
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Forest Layer Battle Challenge 1](#loc=469987)

locations.title: 03 - View from Featherfall Isle
locations.description: **Location:** On top of the leafy platform; punch your way inside the tree and climb to the top to access.

locations.title: 04 - Perched Where Branches Cross
locations.description: **Location:** Buried in the center of the leafy platform.

locations.title: 05 - Shifting above the Forest
locations.description: **Location:** Floating above a Shifty Block, high in the sky of the layer. To access, first climb the tall tree nearby, up to the platform with the wooden ostrich. Throw some Wood at the Shifty Block, then throw the nut at it to grow a bridge to the gem.

locations.title: 06 - Under Featherfall Isle
locations.description: **Location:** On the sandy shore hidden underneath the isle.

locations.title: 07 - Battle: Seed to Succeed
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Forest Layer Battle Challenge 2](#loc=470001)

locations.title: 08 - The Ostrich's Back Snack
locations.description: **Location:** In the center of the distant island. To reach it, climb the tallest wooden ostrich nearby to find a nut; throw it at the wooden ostrich beside the gem to create a bridge to it.

locations.title: 09 - Branching over the PLains
locations.description: **Location:** Buried in the center of the leafy platform; use the [Cannon](#loc=470006) to reach the heights of the tree.

locations.title: 10 - Hopped into Bellhop Burb
locations.description: **Location:** On top of the wooden ostrich.

locations.title: 11 - Blasting Through Brambles
locations.description: **Location:** [Bramble Country](#loc=470008) - Along the main path, on a wooden platform after the first set of cannons.

locations.title: 12 - Back of the Brambles
locations.description: **Location:** [Bramble Country](#loc=470008) - Once you reach the barrels displayed in the screenshot, *exit* the right-most barrel (don't launch yourself). You will fall into the explosive barrel and launch into the gem.

locations.title: 13 - Beat the Brambles
locations.description: **Location:** [Bramble Country](#loc=470008) - At the end of the course.

locations.title: 14 - Bird's-Eye View on Bellhop Burb
locations.description: **Location:** In the center of the isolated island; throw a nut at the wooden ostrich to create a bridge to the gem.

locations.title: 15 - Forest Smashin' Stats
locations.description: **Location:** Given by Fractone after destroying 30,000 cubic meters of thorns across the layer.

locations.title: 16 - Found in the Ostrick Flock
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the wooden pillar with several ostrich heads.

locations.title: 17 - Beneath Bellhop Burb
locations.description: **Location:** Buried just in front of the [Style Shop](#loc=470026)

locations.title: 18 - Battle: Yucky Yard
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Forest Layer Battle Challenge 3](#loc=470027)

locations.title: 19 - Mired in Mud
locations.description: **Location:** Buried in the mud pile, underneath the vegetable.

locations.title: 20 - Tiny Isle in the Wetlands
locations.description: **Location:** In the center of the mudpile, on the small island. To reach, bait the Munchoid coming out of the port on the island to come towards you, then jump and use his body as a bridge to reach the gem.

locations.title: 21 - Shifty Smash: Crossing the Branch
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash Challenge](#loc=470031)

locations.title: 22 - Cranky's Forest Rant
locations.description: **Location:** Given by [Cranky Kong](#loc=470033).

locations.title: 23 - Behind the Big Tree
locations.description: **Location:** On the other side of [Big Tree Getaway](#loc=470037).

locations.title: 24 - Sleeping in the Big Tree
locations.description: **Location:** On a higher ledge on the Big Tree; access from the lower leafy platform nearby by throwing a nut.

locations.title: 25 - Glimmering Overhead
locations.description: **Location:** At the very top of the wooden ostrich.

locations.title: 26 - Checked in at the Eggshell Hotel
locations.description: **Location:** In the open, just beyond the [Eggshell Hotel](#loc=470035) checkpoint.

locations.title: 27 - Atop the Eggshell Hotel
locations.description: **Location:** On top of the hotel.

locations.title: 28 - Lounge Loft and Found
locations.description: **Location:** From the hotel's lobby, fall down the shaft one level and turn right; the gem sits in the center of the closed room.

locations.title: 29 - Hangin' in the Lounge
locations.description: **Location:** From the lobby, fall down the shaft one level and turn around; the gem is hanging from the ceiling. Use the nearby nut to create a bridge with the wooden root behing the gem.

locations.title: 30 - Present by the Pool
locations.description: **Location:** From the hotel lobby, fall down the shaft one level, then turn right into the room. Head to the back wall and fall down one more level, then turn around. Head forward, grabbing the nut, and throw it at the wooden enemy on the otherside of the gap to make a bridge. The gem is beyond that enemy, in the eggshell-shaped building.

locations.title: 31 - Secret Room Service
locations.description: **Location:** [All-You-Can-Eat-Tower](#loc=470049) - Inside the left-most tower along the main path. Lure the Munchoid, then jump and use his body as a bridge to the gem.

locations.title: 32 - Scarfing the Scenery
locations.description: **Location:** [All-You-Can-Eat-Tower](#loc=470049) - On a Neptunium platform, beyond the first pathway.

locations.title: 33 - Wall You Can Eat
locations.description: **Location:** [All-You-Can-Eat-Tower](#loc=470049) - At the end of the course.

locations.title: 34 - Egg-Bottom Basement
locations.description: **Location:** At the very bottom of the hotel. Fall down the ledges until the garden and find the egg-shaped hedge. Pull the vegetable within to reveal a passageway to the basement and the gem.

locations.title: 35 - Egg-Bottom Break-In
locations.description: **Location:** From [34 - Egg-Bottom Basement](#loc=470053), climb the wall to reach the platform on the opposite side of the poison water. Break the wall next to the thorns to reveal a passageway through the outside sand platforms. Use the terrain to destroy the vines to the gem.

locations.title: 36 - A Pain in the Neck
locations.description: **Location:** Buried inside the wooden ostrick's neck. Initially covered in Void Metal; the machine to free it is in the central pillar. Use a nut to create a bridge to the wooden section near the top.

locations.title: 37 - Tucked in Thorn Hollow
locations.description: **Location:** From [Thorn Hollow](#loc=470055), jump up the stairs and break the wall to reveal a hole. Once at the bottom, throw the nearby Boom Rock to the thorns on the left.

locations.title: 38 - Sealed in Thorn Hollow
locations.description: **Location:** In the center of the maze underneath Thorn Hollow.

locations.title: 48 - Forest Chip Exchange
locations.description: **Location:** Purchased from the [Chip Exchange](#loc=470059).

locations.title: 49 - Stuck in the Stump
locations.description: **Location:** In the middle of the stump you arrive on; smash downwards to reveal it.

locations.title: 50 - Plummeted to Mossplume Marsh!

locations.title: 51 - Secret in the Marsh
locations.description: **Location:** Buried underneath the sand.

locations.title: 52 - Shifty Smash: Thwart the Thorns
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash Challenge](#loc=470148)

locations.title: 53 - Beneath the Moving Platform
locations.description: **Location:** Hanging from the moving platform.

locations.title: 54 - Flying to the Sky
locations.description: **Location:** [Ostrich Bananze: Flighty Feast Challenge](#loc=470165) - In the middle of the platform beyond the first set of obstacles.

locations.title: 55 - Soaring through Space
locations.description: **Location:** [Ostrich Bananze: Flighty Feast Challenge](#loc=470165) - On a platform high above the grated bridge. Access by destroying the concrete slab (either with the Egg Bomb power or by luring the enemy to destroy it) and riding the air current.

locations.title: 56 - Gliding through the Heavens

locations.title: 60 - Bouncing to the Top

locations.title: 61 - Forest Hide-and-Seek
62 - Shifty Smash: Rubbery Roost
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash Challenge](#loc=470201)

locations.title: 63 - A View of Mossplume Marsh

locations.title: 64 - Hangin' in the Annex
locations.description: **Location:** At the end of a mesh path underneath the annex. To access, destroy the wall behind the melon to reveal a bouncy block to the mesh.

locations.title: 65 - Bouncy Ballet
locations.description: **Location:** [Bouncing for Bananas](#loc=470249) - In the center of the bouncy maze.

locations.title: 66 - Bouncy Bravado
locations.description: **Location:** [Bouncing for Bananas](#loc=470249) - On top of the tallest pillar rotating around [65 - Bouncy Ballet](#loc=470251). Use the pillars as stairs to the gem.

locations.title: 67 - Bouncy Barriers
locations.description: **Location:** [Bouncing for Bananas](#loc=470249) - At the end of the course.

locations.title: 68 - Under the Rubber PIllar
locations.description: **Location:** Underneath the rubber pillar. To access, pick up the nearby Fractone (near the melon) and throw it at the Shifty Block to make it bouncy.

locations.title: 69 - Beyond Rubbery Roost
locations.description: **Location:** Beside the wooden ostrich's head.

locations.title: 70 - Battle: Three Across the Chasm
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Forest Layer Battle Challenge 5](#loc=470268)

locations.title: 71 - Forest Fragmenstone Recovery
locations.description: **Location:** On the platform leading under the vines. Speak with Fragmenstone, then head to the hole leading to sublayer 603 to find a fragment. Bring it back to Fragmenstone using the nearby nut.

locations.title: 72 - Forest Fragmenstone Restoration
locations.description: **Location:** From [71 - Forest Fragmenstone Recovery](#loc=470270), look out for two islands over the poison water. Fly over the first using the Ostrich transformation, and throw a nut at the wooden Crockoid for the second. Bring the two fragments on that island back.

locations.title: 39 - Off to a Flying Start!
locations.description: **Location:** [Ostrich Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=474550) - On the first platform after the flying section; dodge the spiky columns.

locations.title: 40 - Pretty Thing Preening in a Birdcage
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ostrich Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=474550) - From [39 - Off to a Flying Start!](#loc=474551):
- Turn left and destroy the concrete slab to reveal a fan; use it to fly to the icy platform
- Kill the trailfinoid by punching it towards the left, to create a trail to the rocky platform
- Destroy the concrete slab to reveal a fan. Then, grab a chunk of ground, ride the fan and throw it at the elevator to bring it down
- Finally, step on the elevator and hand slap to release the elevator to the gem.

locations.title: 41 - Survived Sizzle-Wing Circus!
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ostrich Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=474550) - From [39 - Off to a Flying Start!](#loc=474551):
- Turn left and destroy the concrete slab to reveal a fan; use it to fly to the icy platform
- Kill the trailfinoid by punching it forward, to create a trail to the lava platform
- Use Egg Bombs to free the two fans trapped in lava, using them to ascent to the top. Glide to the next platform.
- Glide through the lava rings to the gem.

locations.title: 42 - Faced the Fire and Lasers
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ostrich Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=474550) - From [41 - Survived Sizzle-Wing Circus!](#loc=474553):
- Turn right and ride the cannon to a side-scrolling section
- Grab a chunk of dirt and use Jump Shot to reach the next platform
- Grab another chunk of dirt then enter the cannon. Navigate the lasers, using Jump Shot at the end to reach the gem.

locations.title: 43 - Taking the Low Road
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ostrich Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=474550) - From [39 - Off to a Flying Start!](#loc=474551):
- Turn right and destroy the concrete slab to reveal a fan; use it to fly to the concrete platform.
- Look down to the right of the platform to see a pink platform. Egg bomb it to spawn a blue platform a little ahead; repeat that process two times, following the platform trail.
- This should lead you under the platform to access the gem.

locations.title: 44 - Bounded by Bouncy-Bounce Park
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ostrich Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=474550) - From [39 - Off to a Flying Start!](#loc=474551):
- Turn right and destroy the concrete slab to reveal a fan; use it to fly to the concrete platform.
- Kill the trailfinoid straight forward to access the next platform. Take the cannon.
- Bait the walls into falling, then use them to bounce to higher platforms.
- Bait the munchoids into creating bouncy terrain for you to jump from.
- Start climbing the wall, baiting the burrowing enemies slightly lower. When they come out, stop climbing and bounce off them to reach the higher sections of the wall.
- Bait the spewing enemies into creating trails of bouncy terrain. Towards the end, these trails will rotate upwards; ride them, then once at the top, glide to the gem.

locations.title: 45 - A Peek at the Peak
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ostrich Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=474550) - From [44 - Bounded by Bouncy-Bounce Park](#loc=474556):
- Turn left and ride the cannon to the next platform.
- Bounce from platform to platform to reach the gem. Be careful; most of these platforms are fake Peekaboopoids.

locations.title: 46 - Simmering in the Lava Pond
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ostrich Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=474550) - From [44 - Bounded by Bouncy-Bounce Park](#loc=474556):
- Head right and glide to the floating platform with a lava pool.
- Throw a chunk of concrete at the bomb in the center of the pool, then glide and dive in the center of it to reach the gem.

locations.title: 47 - Topped the Tower of Turbulence!
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ostrich Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=474550) - From [39 - Off to a Flying Start!](#loc=474551):
- Gather both [41 - Survived Sizzle-Wing Circus!](#loc=474553) and [44 - Bounded by Bouncy-Bounce Park](#loc=474556) to bring the Constructones back to the Center Stage.
- Ride the cannon to the top of the tower.
- Glide to the gem, avoiding lasers in the process.
